title: 送報的檸檬
subject: a woman who delivers newspapers by bicycle before dawn down one Tainan lane folds each paper differently for a retired teacher, who hangs one lemon on the gatepost every Friday, and she has been counting the lemons
caption: Guofeng synthwave with guzheng, driving 4/4 outrun pulse. Guzheng plays bright pentatonic arpeggios in sixteenth notes, analog synth bass pulses steady eighth notes, a soft arpeggiated synth shimmers behind the chorus, electronic drum kit with gated snare and four-on-the-floor kick, dizi doubles the hook once. Neon-bright analog gloss, wide stereo. Female voice, clear mid register, smooth and even, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, E minor. Nostalgic, steady, quietly cheerful mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no orchestral strings, no heavy bass drops.
lyrics:
[Intro - guzheng arpeggio over analog synth bass]

[Verse 1]
天還沒亮我踩著腳踏車
報紙捆在後座壓著風
巷子第七戶的老先生
每天要摺成不同的樣子

[Pre-Chorus]
星期一船
星期二帽子

[Chorus]
門柱上掛著一顆檸檬
星期五早上黃黃的
我把它放進車籃
我數到今天十九顆

[Verse 2]
他是退休的國文老師
從不開口只在窗後點頭
我不知道他叫什麼名字
只知道他喜歡酸的

[Pre-Chorus]
今天我摺了一朵花
掛在檸檬旁邊

[Chorus]
門柱上掛著一顆檸檬
旁邊多了一張紙條
寫著明天可以進來喝茶
我數到今天二十顆

[Outro - guzheng and dizi, synth pulse fades]
